records.title: CodEv: An Automated Grading Framework Leveraging Large Language Models for Consistent and Constructive Feedback
records.reason: CodEv applies LLMs to grading programming assignments using constructive feedback and reasoning prompts. The contribution is an application framework, not efficiency.

records.title: Small Languages, Big Models: A Study of Continual Training on Languages of Norway
records.reason: Studies continual training and language coverage for Norwegian and Northern Sámi. Its focus is low-resource-language capability and training data, not inference-cost reduction.

records.title: Toward the Evaluation of Large Language Models Considering Score Variance across Instruction Templates
records.reason: Evaluates how instruction-template variation affects LLM benchmark scores. It is a measurement protocol for evaluation robustness, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Exploration of Masked and Causal Language Modelling for Text Generation
records.reason: Compares masked and causal language modeling for text generation, including quality and generation behavior. It explores generation paradigms but does not establish a concrete inference-cost improvement; retain as adjacent to NAR decoding research.

records.title: HyTra: Hyperclass Transformer for WiFi Fingerprinting-based Indoor Localization
records.reason: Publisher primary full text was not accessible. The title and abstract identify a transformer for WiFi indoor localization, a task-specific sensing application; linked TernaryBERT does not substantiate a compression connection.
